intro: Monaco is a constitutional monarchy ruled by Prince Albert II.

chapters.title: Prince and council
text: The prince holds strong powers, and the elected National Council passes laws. France is responsible for Monaco's defence. Monaco is not in the EU but uses the euro.

chapters.title: Monaco in the world
text: Monaco joined the United Nations in 1993.

keyTerms.meaning: A monarchy whose powers are set by a constitution.
